description: Frozen retrieval test set for the WHO Clinical Use of Blood handbook (rag/who_guidelines.pdf). Created 2026-11-01 before any retrieval variant was run (docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D88).
pages: 1-based PDF page numbers, as stored in the index metadata and shown in citations
labelling: Pages were chosen by reading the handbook text (pymupdf extraction), not by running a retriever. One labeller (the coding agent); a question's pages are every page that states its answer.
not_covered: The handbook (2001) has no dengue section and no donor eligibility intervals, so the set has no such questions.
